mentions.h: Relay Bronze! IAAF WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, ATHENS, 1-10 AUG 1997
20 points clear in the 'Semi' SEMI-FINAL, NEW RIVER STADIUM, HARINGEY, 27 JUL 1997

photos.c: Matt Yates (right) gave one of his best ever Games performances in Budapest, placing 6th in a highly tactical 1500 metres final. John Mayock (left) was 5th and Tony Whiteman (centre) was 4th. No medals but it was great to see all three Brits well in contention in a European Games final again.
